categories.meaning: Programmatic strengthening of tertiary activities around the station, complementary to the old town, Plan-Dessous and Plan-Dessus.
Programmatic preservation or reinforcement of activity uses. The associated A2 text includes existing secondary activities and a reserve objective; not all supports are undeveloped reserves.
named_objectives: Maintain secondary activities north of Bosquets and south of Gilamont.
Revalorise the secondary-activity sector along CFF behind avenue Général-Guisan.
Guarantee a secondary-activity reserve at Cour-aux-Marchandises.
